use_cases: Use as a visually striking landing page background for tech and developer-focused products
Add an immersive animated backdrop to SaaS dashboard or login screens
Create a cyberpunk-style hero section background for creative or gaming portfolios
Implement as an engaging loading screen animation for applications
Use as ambient visual decoration for tech conference presentations or event websites
ai_summary: A dynamic Matrix-style code rain animation built on HTML5 Canvas, featuring customizable green text cascading down the screen with realistic cursor trailing effects. The component offers a settings panel to adjust font size, speed, density, and text color, creating an immersive cyberpunk visual experience suitable for landing pages, hero sections, or ambient backgrounds. Fully responsive and optimized for both desktop and mobile platforms.
